This article is about ore blocks in general. For individual ores, see their pages.

An ore is a mineral block that drops a resource when mined. Ores generate in veins underground; each ore has its own height range.

  • Distribution
  • Mining

The table lists where each overworld ore generates (Java Edition). "Most common" is the height with the most ore.

Deepslate variantsedit

Below Y=0 most ores generate as their deepslate variant, which takes longer to mine and drops the same items.

Miningedit

OreMinimum pickaxeDrops
Coal OreWoodenCoal
Copper OreStoneRaw Copper (2-5)
Iron OreStoneRaw Iron
Lapis Lazuli OreStoneLapis Lazuli (4-9)
Gold OreIronRaw Gold
Redstone OreIronRedstone Dust (4-5)
Diamond OreIronDiamond
Emerald OreIronEmerald

Raw iron, raw copper and raw gold are smelted in a furnace to get ingots. Coal, diamonds, emeralds, lapis and redstone drop directly as items.

Trivia

  • Ores used to generate based on a single uniform range per ore.
